clips.title: The story
paras: Rethban Caverns is an extensive cave system tucked into the northwestern cliffs of the Redridge Mountains. Infested with aggressive Redridge gnolls, it is best known as the sole source of uncommon Rethban ore.

Carved deep into the northwestern mountains overlooking Lake Everstill, Rethban Caverns serves as a fortified redoubt for the local gnolls. Under the cunning leadership of Ardo Dirtpaw, the pack fiercely guards the twisting passages and subterranean chambers, attacking any wanderers who stray too close to their hillside entrance.
